title: Earth's churning mantle may have created the Great Unconformity
summary: Explaining the Great Unconformity, where Cambrian deposits sit on top of older rocks.
llm_summary: The new study suggests that the Earth’s restless mantle—its slow‑moving, convecting interior—helped strip away billions of years of rock, creating the “Great Unconformity,” a massive gap where Cambrian sediments sit directly on much older basement rocks.
